layout.description: Layout asset name written to the custom_hud_layout entity's `layout` keyvalue on sm_hud_create. Empty = create the entity with no layout (still exercises spawn + state writes). Live-reloadable: edit and re-run sm_hud_create.

auto_show.description: Show the panel automatically when a player becomes active, mirroring Valve's OnPlayerActivate -> ShowWelcome. Requires a layout entity to already exist (sm_hud_create).
